question: What cosmic action is performed when reabsorption and creation occur?
premises: The deity desires to withdraw the worlds.
He enters the lotus of the four-faced Brahmā and burns the four worlds.
After burning them, he creates the worlds of people again.
inference: The same divine agency governs both dissolution and renewed creation of the worlds.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the four worlds is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: When he wishes to withdraw the worlds, he enters the lotus of the four-faced Brahmā, burns the four worlds, and then creates the human worlds again.
